title: Housewife
excerpt: Tate McRae released her new single "Housewife" on October 15, her first new song of 2026, together with a music video shot in the south of France.
body:
Tate McRae released her new single "Housewife" on October 15, her first new song of 2026, together with a music video shot in the south of France. Issued through RCA Records, the track arrived eight days after she formally announced it with artwork that showed her in a red bikini beside a baby stroller filled with cash, and the weeks around it turned out to be nearly as telling as the song itself.

The title had been sitting in plain sight since August 2, when the word "Housewife" flashed across the video screens during her set at Lollapalooza in Chicago. Nobody in the crowd, and nobody online, connected the word to an unannounced song. She admitted on *The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon* that her fans reliably miss the obvious clues, and months of guessing proved her point. She described the character at its center as "a woman who can't be contained."

The song turns its domestic title inside out. In the chorus she sings that she wants to "make a lot of money" and be her own housewife, keeping romance optional rather than necessary. Press notes frame the track as a glamorous illusion that slowly fades into a quiet ache, one where absolute freedom can carry the price of real love.

Pierre-Ange Carlotti directed the video, which stages that tension inside a Mediterranean estate. She moves through gardens and a yacht named Tati, dances beside a pool and plays out a relationship that grows increasingly strained, all of it shot with the golden villa gloss the announcement artwork promised. The film ends with her tossing a coin into a wishing well. Tate McRae told Fallon the shoot was "so magical and so fun."

[youtube:DPEodkHzH-s]

"Housewife" is the first release since *So Close to What*, her 2025 album that later stretched into a deluxe edition. The year-long gap between records explains part of the attention around this one, and a tease that planted the answer in August explains the rest.

Three days later, she performed "Housewife" at the Victoria's Secret Fashion Show in Los Angeles, putting the new song in front of a global audience almost immediately. By October 21 a live version cut from the runway was already on streaming services. A song about wanting the money and the house without the husband closed its first week with a runway encore already pressed into the catalog, which sounds less like irony than confirmation.
